name: codegate
description: Desktop skills for setting up and running repository tests, lint and type checks with CodeGate.

interface.longDescription: CodeGate provides desktop skills for setting up a local Git repository and running the tests, lint and type checks declared in codegate.toml. The skills invoke the bundled CodeGate CLI and explain failures. Setup can install repository Git hooks for ordinary commits and pushes. Requires Python 3.11+, Git and a local desktop thread with command execution and repository access. Configured checks run with your local permissions and may modify files or access the network. A passing result means the configured checks passed, not that software is bug-free. Use trusted required CI for enforcement against local bypass.
defaultPrompt: Set up CodeGate in this repository.
Run CodeGate and explain any failing checks.
Check this repository before I commit.

publication.release_notes: Desktop-only skills edition. Setup and check invoke the bundled CLI directly, preserving local repository checks and explicit Git hook installation. This package does not register an MCP server or bundle agent lifecycle hooks.

prompts: Set up CodeGate in this repository.
Run the configured checks and explain any failures.
Check this repository before I commit.
